policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Every episode starts at the first decision step with empty memory and the demonstration shown; the subgoal there is the first letter of the plan just built from the demonstration (plan[0]). At every later decision step (memory carried in, no demonstration shown), first compute one number n = carried moves_done + 1. n is the count of planned moves finished so far, including the one the execution steps just showed, and it is also exactly the moves_done value written at this step; these are the same number, not two different ones, so never add one to n again. The execution steps just completed plan[n - 1]; the subgoal is plan[n] (0-based), the letter immediately after the one just completed. Self-check from what the step shows: the direction the gripper travelled from the first shown execution frame to the scene at this decision step (same dy/dx rule as the plan) must equal plan[n - 1]; the subgoal is the letter right after it in the plan, never plan[n - 1] again (unless the plan genuinely repeats it) and never plan[n + 1]. So the first step performs plan[0]; the second step (carried moves_done = 0, n = 1) performs plan[1]; the third step (carried moves_done = 1, n = 2) performs plan[2]; and so on: the k-th decision step of the episode performs plan[k - 1]. No subgoal needs a point. After a move finishes, the next decision step always advances to the next plan letter regardless of where the gripper ended; never repeat or skip. If n (carried moves_done + 1) is at or beyond the length of the plan (nothing remains), repeat the last plan letter. If the plan could not be built (no demonstration visible and empty plan), derive the direction from the two highlighted targets currently visible if there are two (direction from the older-looking one near the gripper to the other, same dy/dx rule), otherwise choose A: move forward. In any other unforeseen situation, pick plan[n] with n = carried moves_done + 1 if it exists (plan[0] when memory is empty), else A.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters the demonstration traces. If this step shows DEMONSTRATION STEPS (the first step, memory empty), build it now and never change it afterwards: the highlighted target at demo t=0 is the start; each time a different target becomes highlighted in the demo frames, take dy = new y minus previous highlighted y and dx = new x minus previous highlighted x (coordinates at the frame it first appears). |dy| >= 8 with dy > 0 means forward, dy < 0 means backward; |dx| >= 8 with dx > 0 means left, dx < 0 means right; both over threshold means the diagonal (forward=A, backward=B, left=C, right=D, forward-left=E, forward-right=F, backward-left=G, backward-right=H). One letter per newly highlighted target, in demo order. If the step shows no demonstration, copy the carried-in plan character for character. Write the list exactly as a JSON array with double-quoted uppercase letters, square brackets, comma-space separated: ["C", "E", "C", "G"], never ['C', 'E', 'C', 'G'], never without brackets, never with spaces inside the quotes. e.g. ["E", "D", "G", "H"]

fields.name: moves_done
fields.description: How many planned moves have been finished by the scene at this step. Write 0 when the step shows demonstration steps and the carried memory is empty (first step). Otherwise the step shows execution steps of one completed move, so write the carried-in moves_done plus one. e.g. 2
